title: knishle's Dark Cottagecore
description: My vision for Minecraft. A living world, corrupted by darkness. Designed with QOL in mind, beautiful visuals without compromising performance, and no mods required to work.
body:
A living world, corrupted by darkness.

Note: This pack has additional funtionality with Polytone installed, such as custom foliage, fog, terrain, sky, and water colormaps. Polytone is NOT required for 99% of this pack to function.

Inspired by incredible works such as Palettized Programmer Art by TheRealDarkBum, Recrafted by MR_CHOO, Vintage Story, and others, Dark Cottagecore aims to transform the scattered and abstract Minecraft into a single, consistently themed experience.

Video showcase
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/Zpl4UiQVSTQ" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

What you can expect from this pack (currently):

- a light touch of dark fantasy added to your world
- animated foliage across the overworld
- new levels of color and depth
- seasonally themed biomes (If Polytone is installed)
- simplistic, yet smooth textures
- various basic QOL features

What you can expect in the future:
- at minimum, a complete overhaul of the overworld and its creatures
- basic building blocks
- nether overhaul
- tools & armor
- mod support
- resource pack support as addons(e.g. fresh animations)

What you can not expect, and will not be added:

- bushy leaves (maybe as a separate pack in the future)
- any features that require mods to work (besides colormaps)
- changes to fog in general
- resolutions higher than 16x
- respackopts options (subpacks will be consistently uploaded as separate projects)
- building block palettes that are extremely different from vanilla
- features that do not work with Sodium, Nvidium, Distant Horizons, Voxy, etc



As this pack has taken me an incredible amount of time and while likely be a long-term project of mine, I must request that you give CREDIT when you are using this in your modpack.

ALLOWED to use in modpacks. CREDIT REQUIRED. NO re-hosting.



This pack is meant to be my vision for Minecraft, but that doesn't mean I can't accept feedback. After all, it was supposed to be my vision, but made for the community to use. If you have any comments regarding the pack I strongly encourage you to reach out to me.

Got questions or comments regarding the pack? Want to join the discord server to stay updated on upcoming texture changes? Message me @gravitybreacher on discord for an invite.
